newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso reverses early weakness at close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso reverses early weakness at close.

text.p: The Mexican peso recovered earlier weakness to close mixed on Friday after some foreign investors switched from dollar instruments to pesos and some locals sold long dollar positions, traders said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso closed 0.7 of a centavo firmer at 7.8990/7.9040 per dollar, while its 24-hour stablemate closed 0.1 of a centavo weaker at 7.8930/7.8980 per dollar.

"The peso was hit this morning by U.S, financial markets' shaky opening and fallout in the Mexican bourse. Dealers were nervous and bought dollars, which promoted speculators to weaken the peso," said a trader.
